implemented_features: InsightsSection component: source-labeled per-mission metrics. MEASURED (gateway-returned: wallMs, tokens, usd, humanInterventions), DERIVED (UI-computed from events: eventCount, workerCount, reasoningCalls, verificationOk), NOT_AVAILABLE (cost=$0 → 'Not measured' NOT $0 success; learning charts → 'No measurement available').

MetricKind distinction (req: clear measured/derived/unavailable): each metric row shows a badge with the kind (MEASURED/DERIVED/NOT_AVAILABLE) and a one-line description of its source. Cost=$0 in dev mode → NOT_AVAILABLE badge + 'Not measured' display — NEVER $0 success.

Honest notices: 'Per-mission metrics only — no aggregation endpoint exists in v1'; 'Cost=$0 means Not measured, NOT $0 success'; 'Controlled environment — real ZAI/OpenBot integration not claimed; production deployment requires independent verification of G6 operational conditions'.
Learning charts: honest 'No measurement available' notice (Experience JSON not served by gateway in v1; src/learning/ exists but is not wired to a public read endpoint).

Cross-section integration: all 6 sections share the same activeMissionId from the Zustand store. Submitting a goal in Work → auto-navigates to Mission Control → breadcrumb shows mission → Agent/Artifacts/Insights all reference the same mission.

Accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA-oriented — focus-visible rings on all interactive elements; ARIA roles on header/nav/main/aside/footer; aria-live=polite/assertive on status regions; aria-current=page on active nav; prefers-reduced-motion CSS; semantic HTML (main, nav, section, article); NON-color-only status cues (icon + text label on every badge).
Responsive: verified at 360 (mobile drawer), 768 (tablet compact), 1440 (desktop rail); no horizontal overflow; touch targets >=44px (mobile nav button size-11).

Error-state verification: every section handles loading/loaded/empty/error/disconnected states honestly. ConnectionStatus shows Disconnected with retry. EmptyState component for empty surfaces. Stale indicator on stream disconnect.

Security regression: ALL G7-01..G7-05 tests pass — 102/102 total (12 G7-01 closure + 20 G7-02 auth unit + 14 G7-02 auth E2E + 8 G7-02 submission + 20 G7-04 artifacts unit + 13 G7-04 artifacts E2E + 15 G7-05 studio unit).

Two independent verdicts produced (per 06_ACCEPTANCE_AND_TEST_MATRIX §Final verdict): G7_PRODUCT_DEVELOPMENT=PASS (all 6 UI groups implemented against verified gateway contracts); PRODUCTION_DEPLOYMENT=INCONCLUSIVE (requires independent verification of G6 operational conditions: real ZAI/OpenBot providers, restart durability, shutdown idempotency — none verifiable in the controlled environment).
G7-Final-Release-Evidence.zip produced for independent review (contains: exact source SHA, UI captures, gateway matrix, test logs, limitations, operational conditions, provenance, SHA manifest).

verdicts.rationale: G7_PRODUCT_DEVELOPMENT=PASS because all 6 UI groups (Work, Agent, Mission Control, Artifacts & Replay, Studio, Insights) are implemented against verified gateway contracts with 102/102 tests passing. PRODUCTION_DEPLOYMENT=INCONCLUSIVE because the controlled environment uses MemoryComputer + DEVELOPMENT_REASONING_FALLBACK (dev-mode stubs); real ZAI/OpenBot integration, restart durability, shutdown idempotency, and the 5 G6-09C operational conditions remain unverified. Production deployment requires independent verification of these conditions — not merely passing the 6 UI groups.

known_limitations: Controlled environment: GENESIS_EXECUTION_MODE=development uses MemoryComputer + DEVELOPMENT_REASONING_FALLBACK. Real ZAI/OpenBot integration is NOT claimed.
Cost (usd) is $0 in dev mode — shown as 'Not measured' (NOT $0 success). Production cost requires a real provider with costSource callback (not wired in v1).
No aggregation/metrics endpoint exists in gateway v1. Insights shows per-mission metrics only.
Learning charts show 'No measurement available' — Experience JSON is not served by the gateway in v1.
Event stream is polling-based; 100-event cap per response. Replay does NOT imply complete history.
Approvals/Pause/Resume controls NOT shown (gateway v1 doesn't expose WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL).
INTEGRATED_EVIDENCE map for Studio is hardcoded from source inspection at pinned SHA bff7b0a.
G7_PRODUCT_DEVELOPMENT=PASS does NOT imply production readiness. PRODUCTION_DEPLOYMENT=INCONCLUSIVE requires independent verification of G6 operational conditions.
